'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[2024 Iran–Israel conflict]], [[Israel–Hezbollah conflict (2023–present)|Israel–Hezbollah conflict]]
**Five people and a Hezbollah militant killed and five injured in IDF strikes on [[Aadloun]] and [[Ain Qana]] in [[southern Lebanon]].[https://today.lorientlejour.com/article/1415797/hamas-describes-new-roadmap-for-gaza-cease-fire-as-positive-gaza-war-day-239.html (L'Orient le Jour)] 
*[[Sudanese civil war (2023–present)|Sudanese civil war]]
**[[Darfur campaign (2023–present)|Darfur campaign]]
***[[Battle of El Fasher]]
****[[Kutum Hospital airstrike]]
*****The [[Sudanese Armed Forces]] bomb a [[hospital]] in [[Kutum]], [[Sudan]], injuring dozens of people. [https://english.almayadeen.net/news/politics/rsf-bomb-hospital-in-sudan-in-new-war-crime (Al Mayadeen)]
****Around eleven civilians are killed and 42 others are injured in large clashes between the [[Rapid Support Forces]], the Sudanese Armed Forces, and various rebel militia groups in [[El Fasher]], Sudan. [https://sudantribune.com/article286451 (Sudan Tribune)]
**[[Sudan]]’s Ambassador to [[Russia]] confirms willingness of his country to allow construction of a Russian naval base on the Red Sea. [https://sudantribune.com/article286475/ (Sudan Tribune)]
*[[Russian invasion of Ukraine]]
**[[Russian strikes against Ukrainian infrastructure (2022–present)|Russian strikes against Ukrainian infrastructure]]
***[[Russia]] launches [[missile]] and [[Drone warfare|drone strikes]] across [[Ukraine]], injuring at least four people and damaging [[critical infrastructure]], including energy facilities. Ukraine says that it shot down 35 of 53 missiles and 46 of 47 drones. [https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/russias-major-air-attack-damages-ukrainian-energy-infrastructure-5-regions-2024-06-01/ (Reuters)]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*A boat carrying 25 people capsizes in eastern [[Afghanistan]], killing 20 of them. [https://apnews.com/article/afghanistan-river-ferry-sinking-accident-edf8dbab7d7484a9f521a1e548aeba07 (AP)]
*[[2024 Indian heat wave]]
**At least 33 [[India]]n [[election officer|election polling staff]] die from heatstroke in a [[heatwave]] across the country. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2024/6/2/heatstroke-kills-33-polling-staff-in-a-state-on-last-day-of-india-election (Al Jazeera)]

'''Law and crime'''
*[[Capital punishment in Yemen]]
**A court run by the [[Houthis]] in [[Yemen]] sentences 44 people to death on charges of collaborating with the [[Saudi-led intervention in the Yemeni civil war|Saudi coalition]]. [https://abcnews.go.com/International/wireStory/yemens-houthis-sentence-44-death-charges-collaboration-saudi-110741964 (ABC News)]
*[[Vallow–Daybell doomsday murders]]
**A [[jury]] in [[Idaho]], [[United States]], sentences Chad Daybell [[Capital punishment in Idaho|to death]] for the murders of his ex-wife and two of his wife's children. [https://apnews.com/article/idaho-murder-trial-daybell-vallow-children-killed-a294ee6efc7ecb814f67d0e5f5daaf98 (AP)]
*[[Ticketmaster]] and parent company [[Live Nation]] submit an [[U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission|SEC]] filing acknowledging a data breach of customer information potentially affecting 560 million users. [[Banco Santander]] and cloud provider [[Snowflake Inc.]] are also believed to have been affected by the same data breach. [https://www.reuters.com/technology/cybersecurity/live-nation-probing-ticketmaster-hack-amid-user-data-leak-concerns-2024-06-01/ (Reuters)]

'''Politics and elections'''
*[[2024 Icelandic presidential election]]
**[[Icelanders]] vote for the [[President of Iceland]]. Incumbent president [[Guðni Th. Jóhannesson]] had previously announced that he would not be seeking a third term. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2024/6/1/close-race-as-iceland-votes-to-elect-new-president (Al Jazeera)]
**[[Halla Tómasdóttir]] is elected as the President of Iceland with the plurality of the votes at 34.2%. Her opposition [[Katrín Jakobsdóttir]] concedes the election with 25.2%. [https://www.dw.com/en/iceland-tomasdottir-reportedly-wins-tight-presidential-race/a-69239977 (DW)]
*[[2024 Indian general election]]
**The final phase of the general election in [[India]] is held, with the ruling [[National Democratic Alliance]] projected to win a majority. Results will be announced on June 4. [https://www.reuters.com/world/india/india-votes-final-phase-elections-both-modi-rahul-gandhi-eye-victory-2024-06-01/ (Reuters)]

'''Sports'''
*[[2023–24 UEFA Champions League]]
**In [[association football]], [[Real Madrid CF|Real Madrid]] win a [[European Cup and UEFA Champions League records and statistics|record]] 15th [[UEFA Champions League|Champions League]] title after defeating [[Borussia Dortmund]] 2–0 in [[2024 UEFA Champions League final|the final]] at [[Wembley Stadium]] in [[London]], [[England]]. [https://edition.cnn.com/2024/06/01/sport/champions-league-final-borussia-dortmund-real-madrid-spt-intl/index.html (CNN)]
